The '''C-908 Incendiary Missile''' was a model of incendiary [[Missile/Legends|missile]] produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 145 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. A devastating weapon, it combined the power of a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] with the range of a missile.<ref name="DC" />
